Key Findings
  • Month-to-month contract customers churn at a much higher rate than annual or two-year subscribers.
  • Low satisfaction scores (1–2) are the strongest single predictor of churn.
  • Short tenure + high monthly charges is a high-risk combination — new customers paying a lot leave quickly.
  • Random Forest achieved ROC-AUC of 0.733, meaningfully better than random (0.5) baseline.
